title: MCP services — Takeru
description: Explore Takeru’s MCP services. Find connection URLs, available tools, and server status.
headline: Give your AI more to work with.
introFirst: Get the information you need from the AI you already use.
healthDetail: The MCP server responded. Access to 12306 train data is checked when you run a search.
serviceDescription: Search Chinese railway timetables, reference fares, seat availability, and stops. Search across all stations in a city, too.
copyFallback: Select the URL and copy it manually.
example: “Show me trains from Shanghai to Hangzhou tomorrow, with departure times and prices.”
stepOne: Copy the URL for the service you want to use.
stepTwoTitle: Add it to your MCP client
stepTwo: Register the URL, then enter your connection password on the OAuth screen.
stepThree: Enable the connection and ask what you want to know.
note: Access requires a password issued by the service administrator. Fares and seat availability are reference information at the time of query. Confirm travel details with official 12306. Booking, purchases, and payments are not supported.
